paragraphs.text: Pietra "Honk-Honk" McGiggles is a human artificer who works for Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun . She is the Crafter of Clowns , who creates, builds, and programs the park's robotic clowns .

Pietra, being human, is the only clown in the park who is not a robot . She built the Mirthing Pod , the piece of technology that generates more robots. She is serious about comedy and is a highly talented robot engineer, along with being a total goofball. She has managed to combine both of her passions together into "something good for the universe?" She considers making the best clowns ever her life's work.

D00-DL was Pietra's first creation. In her early days, she planned to always put advanced AIs into her robots. She designed D00-DL to scrub the Roil Coaster or be a bellhop. D00-DL's AI allowed him to decide that he didn't want to do what he was told. Pietra since realized that she had to tone down the AI so robots would do what they were programmed for, making D00-DL the only robot in the park with a full personality.
